title: Overnight drain in several staged withdrawals
summary: Between 02:00 and 04:00 an account was emptied through four CASH_OUT transactions of decreasing size, each sized to stay under the customer's usual daily pattern.
signals: the payment was made in the middle of the night
this payment empties the sender's account completely
an unusual number of transactions in a short time
this is a TRANSFER or CASH_OUT
resolution: Third transaction blocked. Customer had been asleep and had not authorised any of them.
lesson: Fraudsters split amounts to stay under thresholds. Judge the sequence, not the single payment.
